features.name: Microsoft Copilot Chat in Business Central
features.description: New Microsoft Copilot Chat capability coming to all Business Central users in the 2026 release wave 2. Allows users to ask natural language questions and get answers grounded in data from Business Central and the web, with citations for verification.

features.name: Business Central Tools
features.description: Tools used by Copilot to access and reason over Business Central data, including tables and customizations, without requiring custom APIs.

features.name: Agentic Loop
features.description: Instead of one-time attempt to find answers, Copilot iterates through multiple tools and data sources via an agentic loop to provide more comprehensive responses.

features.name: Intent Detection
features.description: First step in the copilot reasoning process where it understands what needs to happen based on conversation history and the current question.

features.name: Multi-source Data Integration
features.description: Copilot can combine data from Business Central, web sources, work data, calendar, Outlook, SharePoint, and agents built with Microsoft tools to answer user questions.

features.name: Citations and Verification
features.description: Copilot responses include clickable citation pills that users can click to verify the source data in Business Central. A sources button at the end shows all data copilot accessed.

features.name: Permission Enforcement
features.description: Copilot respects all Business Central user permissions. It runs as the authenticated user and cannot access data the user does not have permission to view.

features.name: Copilot and Agent Capabilities Control
features.description: Admins can fully control who has access to Copilot features in their organization via a dedicated Copilot and Agent Capabilities page where they can opt in or opt out of AI features.

features.name: MCP Server Technology
features.description: Business Central uses the Microsoft Business Central MCP server as the underlying technology for Copilot integration, giving copilot access to all tables and data including from extensions and customizations.

features.name: Extension Guidelines for Copilot
features.description: ISVs can learn guidelines for building extensions that work better with Copilot, including making data more descriptive so agents can work more effectively.

features.name: Conversational Context and Suggestions
features.description: Copilot maintains conversation context and provides suggestions for follow-up questions, enabling multi-turn conversation rather than single prompt-response interactions.

features.name: Rich Output Formatting
features.description: Copilot responses can include rich formatting such as charts, tables, and formatted data representations, not just plain text.

features.name: Progress Messages
features.description: Copilot displays progress messages showing its reasoning steps as it processes a query, providing transparency into how it arrives at answers.

features.name: Vague Query Resolution
features.description: Copilot can resolve ambiguous user input like 'S100' to the correct item 'S100 semi-automatic' by reasoning over Business Central data.

features.name: UI Context Awareness
features.description: Copilot can pull context from the current Business Central page a user is viewing, including data from installed extensions, to help inform its answers.

features.name: User Feedback Loop
features.description: Users can provide feedback on Copilot responses through thumb up button, additional content sharing, screenshots, prompts, and problem reporting to help Microsoft improve the feature.
